notes: R Nathan Ivie, Utah County Commission, 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election', report date 22 June 2020, amendment = No (the 'No' radio is filled). FIVE pages, each classified from its own printed header, never by ordinal: p1 cover / p2 Schedule A sheet 1 (typed) / p3 Schedule A sheet 2 (HANDWRITTEN) / p4 Schedule B / p5 SUMMARY PAGE LAST. Form is modern_boxAF, footer revision 'v. 4.20'. PAGE-FACE NAME is 'R Nathan Ivie'; index.csv's channel label is 'Nathan Ivie' — the page face governs. OFFICE: the page prints only 'Utah County Commission' with NO SEAT, while index.csv carries 'County Commission Seat C'; transcribed as printed and NO seat inferred. A TWO-STOCK FILING: Schedule A sheet 1 is the born-digital fillable form filled by machine type, sheet 2 is the same blank filled BY HAND — both are this report's own sheets (each foliated by the filer 'Page 1' and 'Page 2' respectively, each carrying the same 'Total Contributions Received $14,770'), not a bound-in second report. Every date on both schedules is a bare M/D (or '19 June') with NO YEAR, so every row carries needs_review=1 and no year was supplied from the report date. REDACTION: the county blacked out the street portion of every Schedule A address; the city/state fragment survives beside each bar and is the only locality carried. Schedule B carries no address column at all on this revision. The signature on the cover is redacted by a black bar (the county), while the printed name and date are in the clear. NO in-kind entry appears anywhere on the filing. Both sides close EXACTLY on the promoted per-period boxes (Box B 14,770 / Box D 12,238.52), and the whole cover ladder closes independently (A 232.80 + B 14,770 = F 15,002.80; F - D 12,238.52 = 2,764.28 printed at close), so this filing is fully self-corroborating.
